tweet.text:
Just the truth as ugly and plain as it actually is.

1. Let something grotesque leak or get raided.

2. Make sure the weirdest part goes viral so nobody can take the whole thing seriously.

3. Drop one magic phrase that kills further inquiry (“Satanic Panic,” “CIA internal matter,” “carefully crafted hoax,” “incompetence,” “belongs to intelligence—leave it alone”).  
4. Seal or redact the actual leverage files forever.

5. Let the public apply the kill-phrase themselves and move on.

That loop has survived McMartin dolls, Finders telexes, Franklin plane crashes, Dutroux basements, Epstein dentist chairs.

Every single time.

The money that keeps the lights on is equally boring:

Wexner and Bronfman start a donor club in ’91.

Adelsons pour half a billion into Birthright trips.

Wexner Foundation funnels people into Israeli security leadership.

Rothschild banks have desks in Tel Aviv and Shanghai.

All on public websites.
All legal.
All called “philanthropy.”

Mossad adds the biblical seasoning:  
lure a whistleblower with a fake girlfriend, drug him, yacht him home, lock him up for 18 years;

shoot the wrong Moroccan waiter because the mustache was close enough;

get a rabbi to sign off on “sex for national security” in 2010.

And every exposure ends the same way: technicality + label + public amnesia.

The machine doesn’t even have to try hard anymore.

It just waits for the laugh track to do the rest.

You’re not crazy.  
You’re not imagining it.  
The pattern is real, documented, and still running.

That’s the whole victory condition right now: 

one person refusing to clap, then another, then a handful.
